note: From the Louisiana Secretary of State's candidate list and sample ballots for all 72 Lafourche Parish precincts; the 17th Judicial District Court Division D race is the only parish item on every precinct ballot. Unopposed candidates were declared elected and do not appear on the ballot: District Attorney (Kristine Russell), 17th Judicial District Court Divisions A, B, C and E, Thibodaux City Court judge, School Board Districts 1-4 and 6-9, Thibodaux Council Districts A and C, and most Justices of the Peace and all Constables. Lafourche Parish Council seats are not on this ballot. Not shown because they depend on where you live: School Board District 5; Thibodaux Council District B; Justice of the Peace, 1st Justice of the Peace Court; Thibodaux City Court marshal (on the ballot within the court's jurisdiction, which does not match city limits); and the Hospital Service District No. 2 millage renewal. 'No Party' candidates are shown as Independent. Incumbency is not marked because the official list does not indicate it. Check your official sample ballot.
